'''Jora''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] big game [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] who worked for the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]-based [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]], as Sinasu's chief local leader on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Jora captured some [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] and a small Krayt dragon at Sinasu's request and transported them to the outpost [[Vapor Station]], where he prepared them for shipping to Nar Shaddaa by a group of individuals that were indebted to the Sinasu. However, just as Jora finished briefing the agents for their upcoming mission, the outpost was raided by a band of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. Jora opened fire on the Tuskens with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and directed some of his henchmen to attack the raiders.
